en: The Analysis of the Monastic Rules (Bhikkhuvibhaṅga), First Part.
1.3 Section on Failure (Vipattivāra) Regarding the offenses for one who engages in sexual intercourse: to how many of the four failures do these offenses belong?
The offenses for one who engages in sexual intercourse belong to two of the four failures.
There may be a failure in virtue;

there may be a failure in conduct … [and so on] … Regarding one who, out of disrespect, voids excrement, urine, or spittle in water: to how many of the four failures does the offense committed belong?
Regarding one who, out of disrespect, voids excrement, urine, or spittle in water: the offense belongs to one of the four failures—it belongs to the failure in conduct.
The third section on failure is finished.
